about: Flags checked by a PO and found not to be an issue. tools/flags.py leaves out a flag whose code + title match an entry here (the title holds the counts, so a changed situation raises the flag again) and lists it under 'verified' in data/flags.json.

ok.title: Aceh: 2 package(s) without their own catalog
ok.note: 4★ / 5★ are the catalog's accommodation upgrade of the 3★ package (PT ACEH 4D3N 2026: Grand Arabiya / Kyriad +RM50 and Hermes Palace +RM90 per person per night × 3 nights = hub tierUpgrade RM150 / RM270). Costs = Asonanggroe CR 2026 (4★ / 5★ rows).
